changelog:
**v2.1.0 introduces report-only mode and agent-guided automation.**

- The skill now generates structured diff reports and code modification plans but does not directly modify user code.
- Actual source code changes are performed by the AI Agent using standard code editing tools, based on the generated suggestions.
- Updated documentation to clarify the separation of report generation and code editing, and to support multilingual scenarios.
- Refined the description, triggers, usage instructions, and parameter-to-code API mappings for clarity.
- Adjusted permissions to remove write access, reflecting the report-only architecture.
summary: TRTC SDK configuration inspection and analysis tool. Downloads scene config template Excel, inspection result Excel, and project code from user-provided URLs...
